name: com.michal-chrobot.determinism-validation
description: A comprehensive determinism validation package for Unity DOTS. Supports single-player validation (comparing multiple simulation runs), system-level validation (testing individual ECS systems), and multiplayer deterministic lockstep netcode. Includes debugging tools to identify sources of nondeterminism.

samples.description: Multiplayer Pong game demonstrating deterministic lockstep netcode with up to 4 players and 1000 balls
3D capsules sample demonstrating multiplayer determinism validation with up to 16 players
Simple example demonstrating single-player determinism validation
